description: GLM-5.2 progressive MSRT graph: K2 and K3 bases plus every requested additive increment (K2+1, K2+2, K2+1+1, K2+2+1, K3+1, K3+1+1, K3+2) on all 256 routed experts of every MoE layer, including the MTP layer 78. Nine quantization passes per weight matrix produce nine loadable products between 2 and 5 bits per weight.
